Physical entities in the world do not execute state logic directly. Instead, they delegate logic and networking state to a Persistent State (PS) controller: DoorControllerPS (derived from ScriptableDeviceComponentPS).
To manipulate a door, retrieve its DoorControllerPS and invoke actions through ExecutePSAction.

paragraphs: The DoorControllerPS class exposes explicit action generator methods that return Handle:

- ActionSetOpened(): Forces the door or shutter into an opened state. - ActionSetClosed(): Forces the door into a closed state. - ActionToggleLock(): Unlocks or locks the door, changing isLocked. - ActionToggleOpen(): Toggles the door between opened and closed.

title: Build and load an archive prop
guideTitle: Build and load an archive prop
plainText: 1. Create a WolvenKit project named cybermpkitcube. Add a simple non-skinned single-submesh mesh container from a local game installation, or use one you have permission to redistribute. Copy it to cybermpkit\\diagnostics\\cube.mesh in the project. Choose a clearly visible opaque material and check its dependencies. Keep all original game files in the author's local game installation as the source for any required template and record the template path used. 2. Generate the input with python3 make-cube.py cube.glb. Place the file under the matching raw path cybermpkit/diagnostics/cube.glb. Use WolvenKit's Import/Export tool to import into cube.mesh. The generator writes one triangulated submesh with normals, UV coordinates and tangents. Check the log and mesh preview. Confirm that the selected mesh container has a compatible material slot. 3. Create or derive a simple static entity at cybermpkit\\diagnostics\\cube.ent. Use a mesh component which references cube.mesh. If the selected entity uses appearances, include the necessary resources and record the tested appearance name. Verify references in WolvenKit. The example uses the default appearance candidate 0. Replace it with the appropriate CName hash if the chosen entity needs a named appearance. Record that change with the generated asset. 4. Pack and inspect cybermpkitcube.archive. Confirm the entity and mesh use the expected depot paths. Make a local single-player test installation and spawn the entity by its depot path using a suitable tool such as World Builder. Record the tool and version. Remove that local test installation from the CyberMP test environment before checking resource delivery. Sources. WolvenKit mesh import · WolvenKit project layout · World Builder custom resource inspection.

This recipe demonstrates how to create native Night City interaction prompts in CyberMP client scripts using REDengine's native UI and HUD subsystems.

By combining mp.game.SendInputHintData, MappinSystem.RegisterMappin, and hardware key detection via mp.game.onInputKeyEvent, you can build immersive contextual interaction points (shops, garages, quest boards, doors, ATMs, apartment elevators) without needing heavy custom CEF web overlays.

plainText: A production-grade world interaction prompt in CyberMP consists of three coordinated elements: 1. 3D In-World Marker (MappinSystem): Displays an iconic marker in the 3D world indicating an interactable location or object. 2. Native HUD Button Hint (mp.game.SendInputHintData): Displays the official Cyberpunk 2077 interaction widget (e.g. [F] Interact or [F] Open Garage) at the bottom of the screen when the player is within range. 3. Hardware Input Handling (mp.game.onInputKeyEvent): Captures when the player presses the interaction key (EInputKey.IKF, EInputAction.IACTPress) while in proximity to trigger the client-to-server RPC. ---

plainText: [!WARNING] Singleplayer Scriptable Device Cutscene Hazards In singleplayer Cyberpunk 2077, interacting with certain static devices (such as MirrorDevice, quest terminals, or story intercoms) invokes deep story scripts and scene controllers. 1. Camera Hijacking & Input Lock: Interacting with native singleplayer mirrors (MirrorDevice) or story computers triggers full-body animations and locks the local player's camera and control scheme into a scripted cutscene mode (MenuScenarioCharacterCustomizationMirror or conversation dialogues). 2. Multiplayer Desynchronization: While in a singleplayer scene state, REDengine stops broadcasting player locomotion updates, leading other players to see the player frozen or desynced. 3. The Solution: Do not rely on native singleplayer interactive device triggers for multiplayer gameplay. Instead, construct custom interaction zones using MappinSystem, SendInputHintData, and onInputKeyEvent on EInputKey.IKF. For custom mirror or character customization, trigger the scenario explicitly via mp.game.observeAfter('MenuScenarioPauseMenu', ...) as documented in player-mechanics.md.

title: Vehicles & Physics Reference
plainText: In Cyberpunk 2077, player mounting and unmounting is handled by the engine's gamemountingMountingFacility (mp.game.ScriptGameInstance.GetMountingFacility()). Because CyberMP streams vehicles dynamically based on proximity, attempting to mount a vehicle before it has streamed into the client's local entity pool will fail. A robust mounting implementation checks mp.network.getStreamedPool('CVehicle') first and falls back to listening to the vehicleStreamIn event.

title: Vehicles & Physics Reference
plainText: In Cyberpunk 2077, vehicle destruction consists of multiple independent layers: 1. Deformation grid & glass shatter state: Reset with DestructionResetGrid() and DestructionResetGlass(). 2. Animation controller deformation floats: 10 body panels have blend shape floats that remain deformed unless manually zeroed out via entAnimationControllerComponent.SetInputFloat. 3. Flat tire states: Repaired via ToggleBrokenTire(index, false). 4. Engine smoke and damage visual effects: Updated via UpdateDamageEngineEffects(). 5. Persistent state doors and windows: Reset via vehiclePS.CloseAllVehDoors() and CloseAllVehWindows(). [!NOTE] Calling only vehicleComponent.RepairVehicle() leaves shattered glass, crumpled meshes, punctured tires, and open broken doors intact. All of the following steps must be run for a complete cosmetic and physical repair. ---
